title: CY20105: Inorganic Chemistry I
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisite : CY11001
Structure and bonding: covalent, ionic and metallic bonding. Lattice energy and
defects in solids. Atomic properties & periodicity: ionic and covalent radii,
electronegativity, ionization potential, electron affinity. Acids and bases.
HSAB theory. Chemistry of hydrogen, nitrogen and oxygen.
Book: Inorganic Chemistry by Shriver and Atkins.
